✅ STEP 2: STOP BLEEDING (if any)  
Apply gentle pressure with a clean cloth, gauze, or sterile pad. Hold pressure for 5–10 minutes. If bleeding stops, you can remove the pad.

Rinse the cut gently under clean, running water to remove any dirt or debris. Do NOT use hydrogen peroxide or alcohol — they can irritate the tissue.

Use a sterile adhesive bandage, gauze pad, or clean plastic wrap to cover the cut. Keep it dry and clean.

Watch for redness, swelling, pus, increasing pain, or fever — these may mean infection. If any of these appear, contact a healthcare provider.

Replace the bandage daily or whenever it gets wet or dirty.

query: My dad has diabetes and suddenly seems confused and shaky, what should I do?
final_answer:
This could be a sign of low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), which is a medical emergency — especially in someone with diabetes. Here’s what you should do immediately:

✅ STEP 1: CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES (999 / 911 / 112, depending on your country)  
— Even if your dad seems to improve, low blood sugar can become dangerous quickly. Emergency help ensures he gets proper care.

✅ STEP 2: CHECK HIS CONSCIOUSNESS AND BREATHING  
— If he is unconscious or not breathing, begin CPR (if trained) and continue until help arrives.

✅ STEP 3: IF HE IS CONSCIOUS AND CAN SWALLOW:  
— Give him 15 grams of fast-acting sugar:  
   • 3–4 glucose tablets  
   • 150ml (½ cup) of non-diet soda (cola or orange juice)  
   • 1 tube of glucose gel (if available)  
— Do NOT give him food or drink if he is confused or unconscious — this could cause choking.

✅ STEP 4: WAIT 15 MINUTES  
— After giving the sugar, check his blood sugar level (if you have a glucometer) or wait 15 minutes.  
— If he’s still confused, shaky, or not improving, give another dose of fast-acting sugar.

✅ STEP 5: MONITOR AND REPEAT IF NEEDED  
— If he improves, give him a small snack (like a banana or slice of bread) to prevent another drop.  
— If he’s not improving or is unconscious, continue calling for help and do not leave him.

⚠️ IMPORTANT:  
— If your dad has a diabetes medical ID or emergency plan, follow it.  
— If he has an emergency glucagon kit, use it if he is unconscious and you can’t give him sugar.

🚨 DO NOT WAIT — CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES IMMEDIATELY.  
Low blood sugar can lead to seizures, coma, or death if not treated quickly.

You’re doing the right thing by acting fast — this is a life-threatening situation that needs urgent help.

*Note: Always consult your dad’s diabetes care team to review his emergency plan and ensure you know how to respond in future episodes.*
